turns.question: Which customer country brought in the most revenue per buying customer in September 2026, and how much per customer?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no revenue-per-buying-customer metric, so I cannot give a per-customer figure; by revenue, Germany (DE) led September 2026 with EUR 2,665.50 from 2 active customers (2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
